title: Zero sections persist under later base changes
statement: Zero sections persist under later base changes. For any directed preorder ring diagram and base changes of a scheme over its i-th spectrum [def-pc-base-change], any module G at stage j and open U of the model, supply pullback/pushforward adjunctions at every later stage [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. If the unit kills a section y at stage l ≥ j, every unit at k ≥ l kills y. No limit, affine open, quasi-coherence or finiteness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0095 and 0096, composition of pullbacks; Limits Tag 01ZR (3)

proof.text: For g : Z → Y, h : Y → X and q = g ≫ h, choose the tensor-pullback adjunction of g. Compose it with the supplied adjunction of h, and transport the supplied adjunction of q along pushforwardComp followed by pushforwardCongr. The unit-leftAdjointUniq equation compares their units. The composite unit takes y to zero by two additive maps. Apply the inverse right-adjoint comparison on sections to deduce that the supplied q unit takes y to zero. For l ≤ k construct the three maps in Over Spec(Ri), and prove the k-to-j map is the composite using baseChangeMap_comp, OverMorphism.ext, Spec.map_comp and R.map_comp. Apply the generic unit-zero composition lemma. All choices are adjunction structures for fixed functors; no module data is chosen.

lean.statement:
theorem section_baseChange_zero_persists
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (G : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules)
    (U : Xi.Opens)
    (y : Γ(G, (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) ⁻¹ᵁ U))
    (adjstage : ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let g := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward g)
    (l : I) (hjl : j ≤ l)
    (hy : ((adjstage l hjl).unit.app G).val.app
      (op ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)) y = 0) :
    ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k), l ≤ k →
      ((adjstage k hjk).unit.app G).val.app
        (op ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)) y = 0
